name: ByteDefense Security
author: ByteDefense

sections.description:
ByteDefense Scanner is your ultimate WordPress security companion, designed to safeguard your website from malicious threats, vulnerabilities, and potential exploits. Whether you’re running a blog, an e-commerce store, or a business site, this plugin offers a robust scanning solution that identifies risks in both your site’s files and database, providing peace of mind—all within a sleek, intuitive interface. Additionally, with the new GEO Protection feature, you can control access to your site based on visitors’ geographic locations, enhancing security and compliance with regional regulations.

Why Choose ByteDefense Scanner?

  • Fast & Thorough File Scanning: Detects malware, suspicious files, and security loopholes in as little as a few minutes (up to 15 minutes for larger sites).
  • Database Security Scanning: Scans your WordPress database (posts, meta, and options) for inserted malicious links, injected JavaScript, hidden content, iframes, and other suspicious patterns.
  • GEO Protection: Restrict access to your site by blocking visitors from specific countries, managing IP access (allow or ban specific IPs/subnets), and controlling bot access—all powered by the MaxMind GeoIP database.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: Easily navigate through the “Scan & Report,” “Database Scan,” “GEO Protection,” and “Support” tabs—no technical expertise required!
  • Real-Time Feedback: Watch the scanning process with a beautiful AJAX loader, ensuring you know exactly when your site is being checked.
  • High Performance: Built with WordPress best practices, ensuring minimal impact on your site’s speed and resources.
  • Future-Ready: Designed by ByteDefense Team, this plugin is poised for continuous updates and cutting-edge security features.

Imagine a tool that not only protects your site but also empowers you with actionable insights and advanced access control. ByteDefense Scanner doesn’t just stop at scanning—it’s a gateway to a safer, stronger WordPress experience. With cyber threats on the rise, this plugin is your first line of defense, offering enterprise-level security at the fingertips of every WordPress user.

Key Features

  • One-Click File Scanning: Simply press the “Scan” button to initiate a deep analysis of your site’s files.
  • Database Scanning: Scan your WordPress database for malicious links, injected scripts, hidden content, iframes, and other threats with a single click.
  • GEO Protection (New): Block visitors from specific countries, whitelist or blacklist IPs/subnets, and control bot access.
  • Customizable Settings: Tailor the plugin to your needs (settings tab coming soon with more options!).
  • Dedicated Support: Access help directly from the plugin interface—because your security matters.
  • AJAX-Powered Interface: Smooth, modern design with real-time updates during scans.
  • Translation-Ready: Built with localization in mind, making it accessible to users worldwide.

The Power of Prevention

Cyberattacks can cost you traffic, revenue, and reputation. ByteDefense Scanner helps you stay ahead of the curve by identifying issues before they become problems. Whether it’s a hidden backdoor in your files, outdated code, malicious content injected into your database, or unauthorized access from specific regions, this plugin has you covered. Don’t wait for a breach—act now and secure your WordPress site with a tool trusted by thousands (and growing!).

Built for Everyone

From beginners to developers, ByteDefense Scanner balances simplicity with power. Its clean design and clear instructions make it accessible, while its extensible framework allows advanced users to customize the scanning process and access control settings.

Download ByteDefense Scanner today and join a community dedicated to WordPress security excellence. Your website deserves the best—give it the protection it needs!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bytedefense-scanner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “ByteDefense” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click “Scan & Report” to scan your site’s files, “Database Scan” to check your WordPress database for threats, or “GEO Protection” to configure location-based access control.
sections.faq:
What does ByteDefense Scanner do?

ByteDefense Scanner scans your WordPress site’s files and database for malware, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activity. It checks for malicious links, injected scripts, hidden content, and other threats, ensuring your website stays safe and secure. Additionally, it offers GEO Protection to control access based on visitors’ geographic locations.

How long does a scan take?

For most sites, file scanning takes just a few minutes, while larger sites may take up to 15 minutes. Database scanning typically completes in a few minutes, depending on the size of your database. You’ll see a beautiful loading animation while it works its magic!

Do I need technical skills to use this plugin?

Not at all! ByteDefense Scanner is designed with simplicity in mind. Just click “Scan,” “Scan Database,” or configure GEO Protection settings, and let it do the heavy lifting.

Is it safe to run the scanner on my live site?

Yes! The plugin is built with WordPress best practices and runs efficiently without disrupting your site’s performance. It’s lightweight and secure.

What happens after a scan?

Once the scan completes, the page refreshes, and you’ll see the results (future updates will include detailed reports). For now, it confirms the scan is done with a “SCAN_DONE” or “DATABASE_SCAN_DONE” message.

Is support available if I run into issues?

Yes! Head to the “Support” tab in the plugin interface for assistance. ByteDefense Team is committed to helping you secure your site.

Will this slow down my website?

No. ByteDefense Scanner is optimized for performance and only runs when you initiate a scan, ensuring zero impact on your visitors.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the base version is free! Future premium features may be added, but the core file and database scanning functionality, as well as GEO Protection integration, is yours at no cost.

What is GEO Protection, and how does it work?

GEO Protection allows you to control access to your WordPress site based on visitors’ geographic locations. It integrates with the GEO Visitor Control plugin (available on WordPress.org) to block visitors from specific countries, manage IP access (allow or ban IPs/subnets), and control bot access using the MaxMind GeoIP database. To use this feature, you need to install and activate the GEO Visitor Control plugin, which ByteDefense Scanner will automatically redirect you to upon accessing the “GEO Protection” tab.

Do I need any additional setup for GEO Protection to work?

Yes, GEO Protection requires the GEO Visitor Control plugin to be installed and activated. Additionally, you’ll need to download the GeoLite2 database (free) or a paid MaxMind database and place it in the /geo folder of the GEO Visitor Control plugin for country-based blocking to function. No API key is required for basic functionality.

Can I allow specific IPs to bypass GEO Protection restrictions?

Yes! With GEO Protection (via the GEO Visitor Control plugin), you can add trusted IPs or subnets (e.g., your team or VPN) to the “Allowed IPs” list, ensuring they bypass all other restrictions.
